children: The PC market slumped more than 20% year-over-year in the third-quarter, research firm IDC said on Thursday, as supply constraints and inventory pull-in weighed on sales. Despite the downturn, Apple
managed to fare better than the overall market and gained share, IDC added.

Shipments during the quarter hit 62.7M, IDC said, down 20.1% year-over-year. The drop marked the second straight quarterly decline and a significantly larger drop than the 3.8% decline seen in the second quarter, IDC added. Shipments fell 9.1% sequentially, notable given the third quarter has historically outpaced the second quarter.

“What we’re seeing is the result of the strong first half pull-in,” said Jitesh Ubrani, research director for consumer devices at IDC, in a statement. “Vendors and channels loaded up on inventory early in the year to get ahead of price hikes, and that has thrown off the usual seasonality, where Q3 is typically larger than Q2. Channels are now worried about carrying too much inventory into a market where high prices are suppressing demand. That could translate into promotions and some short-term relief for consumers, but we don’t expect pricing anywhere near what it was a year ago. Prices will remain elevated. With macro conditions worsening, the risk is that the outlook for the next few quarters gets worse before it gets better.”

Lenovo was the leading PC vendor during the quarter, as it shipped 14.9M PCs and accounted for 23.8% of the market. That's down from the third-quarter of 2025, when the company shipped 19.3M units and had 24.6% of the market, IDC added.

Apple outperformed the broader market and ended the period with 9.5% of the market, up from the third quarter of 2025 when it held 8.5% of the market. However, like its peers, Apple also shipped fewer units, with 5.9M units shipped during the quarter, down from 6.7M in the year ago period, IDC added.
, and Asus constituted the rest of the top five vendors. The trio held 16.5%, 12.1%, and 8.7% of the market in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 19.1%, 12.9%, and 7.6%, respectively.
Units shipped for the trio during the quarter were 10.3M, 7.6M, and 5.5M, respectively.

title: Apple gains share even as PC market slumps in Q3, IDC says
